service.description:
What the Inbox, MessageDetail, Compose and Home screens call for each of their operations (plans/Comms-Framework.md §3.3, A3). An app that keeps the user's messages beyond mail (IronStone's Internal account and mailboxes) answers the operations through its inbox-source provider, and its answer is the whole answer: its page is the list, nothing is joined to it. Otherwise the framework answers the operations it has, over the user's mail alone (this file, ComposeServices, CommsHomeServices); an operation only an app has (a mailbox, filing on a record, an invitation) is refused as not available here.
The provider is called as the app that declares it (org.moqui.ui.ShellServices.call#Providers, hook inbox-source) with operation and parameters, and answers handled and result (the operation's out-parameters). A read runs in its own transaction; a provider that fails is an error, so a page never comes back without the app's messages it should have.
get#MailChanges is the mail change cursor (EmailClientServices.get#MailChanges): an app's provider that does not answer it gets result {unsupported: true}, as the framework's log knows nothing of the app's own messages; the client then reads its folders again instead. A provider that answers it covers every store of its Inbox but those its result names in uncoveredStores (IronStone: internal, whose messages have no change log): the client reads those stores' threads again each time and takes the rest from the cursor. set#ThreadState and apply#ViewAction with parameters.clientRef (the client's own reference of the request, ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$) run once per reference, the provider's answer too: one sent again answers the first one's result with duplicate true and does nothing (ClientSyncServices.claim#ClientRequest).

parameter.name: source
parameter.description: The provider that answered (its sourceId), or empty for the framework

service.description: The rail and the user's settings, of the user's mail accounts alone: the accounts (org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.get#UserEmailAccounts: each mail account with its folders by kind and path, labels, identities, unread, draft and Outbox counts, and its sync state: syncing while its sync lock holds, a warning when its sign-in or its last sync failed), no mailboxes (an app's), the saved searches, the Unified, Drafts and Outbox totals, me (the user, party and own addresses) and the Inbox preferences (reading pane, pane sizes, the rail collapsed, archive opens next, mark read after seconds, the undo-send seconds, threads or messages, the default account, signature placement, the two phone swipe actions, the trusted senders, and remoteImages: always shows the pictures of every sender; MailSettingsServices.set#MailDefaults). Each mail account has usedBytes and storageText: the bytes its files use under dbresource://email/, sized the way FileServices sizes a drive (ec.resource.getTreeSize). Mail has no quota of its own, so the line is the size only. A part that fails is named in failedParts and logged; the rest is answered. A size that cannot be read is logged and that account's line is left out.

parameter.name: outOfOfficeList
parameter.description: The accounts whose automatic reply is on now ({emailAccountId, accountName}), for the Inbox's out-of-office banner

service.description: Remote images of a sender shown at once from now on (or not, with remove): the user preference MAIL_TRUSTED_SENDERS, a JSON list of addresses in lower case.

A page of the thread list of the user's mail (org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.find#Messages) for a view of the rail: inbox (every account's Inbox), flagged, snoozed, scheduled, drafts, sent, archive, junk, trash, outbox and all, with emailAccountId one account's (and emailFolderId one folder, emailLabelId one label). A search (searchText, with Gmail's operators) is a view of all mail, or of the account open, unless it names an in:. MAIL_CONVERSATION messages lists the mail one message at a time (threadMode false); threads, the default, keeps a thread as one row. The cursor is email:millis of the last row's sortDate. termList is the search's operators for the query chips. conversationView is the mode this page used.

parameter.name: findView
parameter.description: The view find#InboxThreads was asked for

service.description: The thread of the reading pane, oldest message first, through org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.get#Thread ("not found" for a thread the user may not see). Each message has its sender and recipients, date, HTML or text body, attachments (inline ones in cidMap by Content-ID), its flags and how it may be unsubscribed. The thread has its labels and what the user may do: reply (canReply), send from its account (canSend). The records a message is filed on, its contacts and the invitation it carries are an app's (its inbox-source answers this operation).

The file of an attachment the user may read: a mail attachment (EmailMessageAttachment) of a message get#Thread shows the user. Anything else is "not found". inlineAllowed is true for an image or a PDF.

Save to Files: a copy of a mail message's attachments in a folder of a drive (save#FilesToDrive). id is one attachment (store email, the id get#MessageAttachment reads, which checks that the user may read its message); without an id, emailMessageId copies every file of that message, when get#Thread shows the message to the user. The message keeps its own copies. A message the user may not read is "Attachment not found"; a folder the user may not write is refused by FileServices.upload#Resource.

parameter.name: savedList
parameter.description: {name, path, outcome created, replaced or renamed}

service.description: Internal, for a Save to Files that checked the user may read each file (save#MessageFiles, an app's own for its messages): a copy of each file ({name, location}) in a folder of a drive through FileServices.upload#Resource as the user, keepBoth when the name is already there ("name (2).ext"). Each file is saved in a transaction of its own: one that fails is named in failedList and logged, and the others are saved; when none is saved the first failure is the error. No files is "This message has no files".

An action on mail threads (a list's selection, a row's hover action, the reading pane's bar), each target {store email, threadId, emailMessageId (one message instead of the thread), seen}. Actions: read, unread, flag (the thread's newest message, or the message), unflag, archive, unarchive, trash, deleteForever (mail in Trash), spam and notSpam, snooze (snoozedThruDate) and unsnooze, move (emailFolderId), labels (addLabelIdList and removeLabelIdList, through apply#Labels). Mail goes through org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices (set#MessageFlags, archive#Messages, trash#Messages, report#Spam, snooze#Messages, move#Messages, apply#Labels); each checks the user's access, and a target the user does not reach is "not found". Each target is changed in a transaction of its own: one that is refused or fails is named in failedList ({key, message}) with why, and the others are changed.
seen, on a target a client queued offline, is the state the client saw for the fields its action changes ({isRead}, {isFlagged}, {archived}, {snoozedThruDate}, {emailFolderId}, {labelIds}, and latestMessageId, the newest message the client saw, so a read or archive does not take a message that came since; EmailClientServices.check#SeenState reads them for a thread, a flag's on the message it flags, labels only those the action adds or removes): when the server's differs, the target is left as it is and named in failedList with reason conflict and current, the state now, which the client shows (the server's change wins). A clientRef makes the request once (run#Operation).

parameter.name: targetsJson
parameter.description: The targets as JSON, from a form

service.description: A bulk action on every thread of a view ("all N in this view"): the view's threads by find#InboxRows (the same parameters as the list, at most 5000), then set#ThreadState on them.

actions.script: const targets = [] let cursor = null for (let page = 0; page < 25; page++) { const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.find#InboxRows').parameters({view: view, emailAccountId: emailAccountId, emailFolderId: emailFolderId, emailLabelId: emailLabelId, contactListId: contactListId, searchText: searchText, unreadOnly: unreadOnly, cursor: cursor, pageSize: 200}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return for (const row of Array.from(out.threadList || [])) targets.push({store: row.store, threadId: row.threadId, lastEmailMessageId: row.lastEmailMessageId ?? null, lastCommEventId: row.lastCommEventId ?? null}) cursor = out.nextCursor if (!out.hasMore || !cursor || targets.length >= 5000) break } threadCount = targets.length updatedCount = 0 failedList = [] if (targets.length === 0) return const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.set#ThreadState').parameters({targetList: targets.slice(0, 5000), action: action, snoozedThruDate: snoozedThruDate, emailFolderId: targetEmailFolderId, addLabelIdList: addLabelIdList, removeLabelIdList: removeLabelIdList}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return updatedCount = out.updatedCount failedList = out.failedList

service.description: The palette's Messages group: the user's mail whose text matches (find#InboxRows with the search line, so its operators work), each a row {title, subtitle, icon, url} to the Inbox under comms_app_root. moreUrl is the Inbox's search.

One message for MessageDetail: an email of an account the user reaches (get#Thread with its headers), or mail the system sent (no account: notifications and other mail) for a user of the ADMIN group, by emailMessageId. Anything else is "not found" (a message of an app's, by communicationEventId, is answered by its inbox-source). detail has the header fields, the body, the files, the raw headers, and what the user may do: open it in the Inbox (threadKey), resend it (a bounced message of an account the user may send from, or system mail for an administrator).
